research.title: Predictive Calibration under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare probability calibration methods under controlled covariate shifts in synthetic and tabular classification datasets.
Evaluated temperature scaling and isotonic regression using held-out calibration sets, reliability diagrams, and bootstrap uncertainty estimates across predefined shift conditions.

work.title: Order Processing and Inventory Coordination
bullets: Processed incoming orders, checked shipment documentation against purchase records, and coordinated corrections with warehouse staff before dispatch.
Maintained inventory logs, reconciled delivery discrepancies, and prepared routine handover notes documenting outstanding requests and scheduled follow-up actions.

projects.title: Regularization for Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression pipelines with standardized predictors and cross-validation for selecting regularization parameters.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability on synthetic datasets with correlated features, using repeated train-test splits and controlled noise settings.

projects.title: Missing-Data Strategies for Tabular Classification
bullets: Implemented median and nearest-neighbor imputation pipelines for logistic regression and random forest classifiers under simulated missing-data mechanisms.
Compared discrimination and calibration across missingness patterns, fitting imputers within training folds to prevent information leakage during evaluation.
